# Grand Valley State University

> > Grand Valley State University (GVSU) is a comprehensive public university in Michigan offering undergraduate and graduate programs across computing, health professions, education, liberal arts, and business.

GVSU serves students across campuses in Allendale and Grand Rapids, with particular strengths in cybersecurity, health sciences, teacher education, and international studies. The university emphasizes applied learning, professional development, and interdisciplinary collaboration through its colleges of Computing, Health Professions, Education and Community Innovation, and liberal arts programs.

## Graduate Programs

- [Combined Degree: Cybersecurity, B.S. and M.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/combined-degree-cybersecurity-bs-and-ms.htm): Accelerated BS/MS Cybersecurity program at School of Computing
- [Medical Dosimetry M.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/medical-dosimetry-ms.htm): JRCERT-accredited Medical Dosimetry MS with hybrid-online format
- [School Psychology M.S., Psy.S](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/school-psychology-ms-psys.htm): NASP-approved School Psychology MS/Specialist degree with practicum
- [Professional Science Masters M.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/professional-science-masters-ms.htm): PSM in applied statistics, biostatistics, and health informatics
- [Communications M.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/communications-ms.htm): Communications MS in strategic communication and digital media leadership
- [Graduate Teacher Certification - Elementary Education C](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/graduate-teacher-certification-elementary-education-c.htm): PK-6 teacher certification, hybrid cohort-based three-semester program

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Applied Food and Nutrition B.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/applied-food-and-nutrition-bs.htm): ACEND-accredited BS preparing Registered Dietitian Nutritionists
- [International Relations B.A.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/international-relations-ba.htm): International Relations BA in Political Science with study abroad
- [Computing B.A.S.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/computing-bas.htm): Applied Computing BAS for transfer students with technical associates
- [Business, General B.B.A.](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/business-general-bba.htm): General Business BBA at Seidman College of Business

## Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics

- [Cybersecurity Graduate Badge](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/cybersecurity-graduate-badge.htm): Graduate badge in network security, ethical hacking, and digital forensics
- [Digital Forensics Fundamentals Graduate Badge](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/digital-forensics-fundamentals-graduate-badge.htm): Graduate badge in cyber forensics and digital evidence investigation

## Academic Minors and Interdisciplinary Programs

- [International Relations Minor](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/international-relations-minor.htm): International Relations minor in Political Science at GVSU
- [Environmental Science Minor](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/environmental-science-minor.htm): Environmental Science minor, 22-credit interdisciplinary program
- [Africana Studies](https://www.gvsu.edu/aaas): Africana Studies minor exploring African American and African diaspora

## Schools and Academic Departments

- [School of Criminology, Criminal Justice, and Legal Studies](https://www.gvsu.edu/cj): Criminal Justice, Criminology, and Legal Studies programs with LEAP

## Centers and Special Initiatives

- [START Project](https://www.gvsu.edu/autismcenter): Michigan autism education center providing evidence-based teacher training
- [Padnos/Sarosik Center for Civil Discourse](https://www.gvsu.edu/civildiscourse): Padnos/Sarosik Center promoting respectful dialogue and civil discourse

## Optional

- [Palliative and Hospice Care I Graduate Badge](https://www.gvsu.edu/academics/palliative-and-hospice-care-i-graduate-badge.htm): Graduate badge in end-of-life care with digital credentials via Credly
- [Carillons of Grand Valley State University](https://www.gvsu.edu/carillons): Beckering and Cook Carillon towers with live bell performances
